author: Marlon Chaviano
name: vscode-extension
title: VS Code extension
description: A VS Code (and Cursor) extension in TypeScript: commands, settings and F5 debugging ready, packageable with vsce.

base.command: mkdir {{name}} && cd {{name}} && printf '%s\n' '{"name": "{{name}}", "version": "0.1.0", "private": true, "displayName": "{{name}}", "description": "", "publisher": "tu-publisher", "main": "./dist/extension.js", "engines": {"vscode": "^1.95.0"}, "categories": ["Other"], "activationEvents": [], "contributes": {"commands": [{"command": "{{name}}.helloWorld", "title": "Hello World"}]}}' > package.json

setupTasks: VS Code: set your `publisher` and `displayName` in `package.json` before publishing (`npx vsce publish`).
instructions:
## How to work here

- Each command is declared in `contributes.commands` in `package.json` **and** registered in `src/extension.ts` with `vscode.commands.registerCommand` (same id in both places).
- Put everything you register into `context.subscriptions` so it's released when the extension is deactivated.
- Press F5 to open a VS Code window with the extension loaded.
- Before finishing: `npm run build`. To package: `npm run package` (produces the `.vsix`).
